summary: Mergeable with minor issues: the patch is a good start, but some edge cases might be missed and the test coverage could be improved.

issues.description: Some edge cases might be missed, e.g., when printing Limit with dir='-' or when printing Eq with a non-integer rhs.
The patch only includes tests for the specific failing cases, but it would be better to have more comprehensive test coverage for the StrPrinter class.

The patch uses the _print method to recursively print expressions, but it would be more consistent with the project conventions to use the _print method only when necessary and use the str method otherwise.
The patch is a good start, but it would be better to have a more general solution that doesn't rely on special-casing the failing tests.
